chunks: The delaying of payment by a wealthy person is injustice.

key_terms.الْغَنِيِّ: the one who is financially able and possesses sufficient means
key_terms.ظُلْمٌ: injustice; wrongfully violating another person's right
key_terms.مَطْلُ: delaying or postponing the fulfillment of a due payment

ai.seo_question: What does Islam say about a wealthy person delaying payment of a debt?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when a person who is able to pay a due debt delays it, that delay is an act of ظلم (injustice). It highlights the moral and legal seriousness of fulfilling the financial rights of others without wrongful postponement.
